title: Remove link
purpose: Remove a link from a ticket or a client organization with a reason, keeping the link's history.
summary: Take a link off a ticket or an organization and say why. The link stays listed as removed, with its history. Person-level links can be removed only with the Can view patient information permission.

tasks.title: Remove a link
steps: Check the link shown above the field.
Write the [[Reason for removal]] and select [[Remove link]].

good_to_know: A reason is required. It is kept with the removal and shown in the removed list.
Removing takes the link off this ticket or organization only. Other tickets that carry the same record keep it.
Removal cannot be undone, but the link can be added again.
For a person-level link, staff without the permission get a not found page, and the page is not cached.
A link on a closed ticket cannot be removed: the ticket's links are frozen once it is closed.

items.label: Link summary
items.description: The link's label, its record type and its role. For a person-level link it reads the record type followed by link, never the label or key.

items.label: Reason for removal
items.description: Required. Kept with the link's history. The link stays listed as removed. For a person-level link, choose the reason from the list instead (Wrong person, Entered in error, No longer needed, Other); the history and the timeline record only that choice.

items.label: Remove link
items.description: Marks the link removed, with who, when and why, and returns to the ticket's or organization's Links section. The attachment row is never deleted. On a ticket, a removal event is added to the timeline with the record type and no label or key. Removing a ticket's link changes the ticket: a form on a page of it opened before is refused as stale.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket or organization without removing anything.

items.label: Already removed
items.description: If the link was already removed, a notice says so and no form is shown. Its history stays on the link's page.

items.label: Note
items.description: Person-level links only, optional, up to 500 characters. Kept on the removed link's row on the ticket and shown only to staff with the Can view patient information permission. Never written to the history or the timeline.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Every staff role can remove a link that is not person-level, on a ticket it can read or on any organization. A ticket you cannot read, or a person-level link without the permission, answers not found. Client portal accounts are refused.
